title: Chapter 3: the object tracker goes dark and the cube moves
judge_reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it
agent_summary: The red cube was picked and placed in the green target zone at [0.50, -0.25], and check_task reported success. After the first approach move, the object tracker died and stopped reporting the cube's position. I used top-camera vision (locate_object) instead, which found the cube at about [0.58, 0.12], not at its reported start of [0.50, 0.00]; the top image and the wrist camera both confirmed this before I grasped. The grasp held (opening 0.0395 m), every move reached with under 1 mm error, and the front camera shows the cube sitting on the zone with the open gripper clear above it.
